{
  "cypher": "MATCH (sp:Country {name: "Spain"})
MATCH (c:Country)
WHERE c <> sp
MATCH (rSp:River)-[:partOf]->(db:DrainageBasin)
MATCH (rSp)-[:flowsThrough]->(sp)
MATCH (rC:River)-[:partOf]->(db)
MATCH (rC)-[:flowsThrough]->(c)
RETURN c.name AS country, count(DISTINCT db) AS drainageBasinCount
ORDER BY drainageBasinCount DESC"
  ,
  "rationale": "A drainage basin is considered "located in" a country when a river that is part of that basin flows through the country. }

MATCH (r)-[:partOf]->(b:DrainageBasin)

UNION
/* Drainage basins that the Tshopo River is part of */
MATCH (r:River {name: "Tshopo"})-[:partOf]->(b:DrainageBasin)
RETURN DISTINCT b.name AS drainageBasinName"
}
